decisions.statement: 所有者 dahatake が 2026-09-24 05:56 JST に「B: A」と回答し、G2D-09 は選択肢 A（ATG planning 規約の改訂）。敵対的レビュー blocking 0

verification.command: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command "$f = 'docs/model-governance/evidence/2026-09-24-owner-ruling-G2D-09.md'; if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { exit 1 }; $t = Get-Content $f -Raw -Encoding utf8; if ($t -cnotmatch '(?m)^選択: (A|B)\r?$') { exit 1 }; if ($t -cnotmatch '(?m)^\| 決定日 \| \*\*2026-09-24\*\*') { exit 1 }; if ($t -cnotmatch '(?m)^> B: A\r?$') { exit 1 }; if ($t -cnotmatch '(?m)^## 根拠\r?$' -or -not $t.Contains('requirement-definition.md')) { exit 1 }; if (-not $t.Contains('判断者') -or $t -cnotmatch '(?m)^## 本判断が意味しないこと\r?$') { exit 1 }; if (-not (Select-String -Path 'work/20260924-0620-Gate2Prep2-G2D-09-Review.md' -Pattern '^blocking: 0$' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }; $env:PATH = \"$env:LOCALAPPDATA\npm-12.0.0;$env:PATH\"; if ((npm --version) -ne '12.0.0') { exit 2 }; npm run verify:docs; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }"
